comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and verifies gripper hardware; PR-262 installs and closes a personal padlock through a group lockout hasp.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate performs coaxial screw/nut manipulation under torque; PR-262 performs articulated shackle alignment, insertion through paired holes, and snap closure without disturbing another lock.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a retained angular setting over cycles; PR-262 requires the added padlock to keep the hasp and disconnect handle secured under hold tests.
comparison.reason: Both involve locking, but PR-262 tests safety-lock insertion and isolation rather than preserving a calibrated adjustment.
